description: Recursive: Flint (free) via OpenRouter. Flint is an open-weight mixture-of-experts model from Recursive, with about 2.5B active parameters out of 40B total, built by Recursive's autoresearch system Eureka Machine for coding agents. It is suited
notes: 40B MoE (2.5B active) built for coding agents; free tier is rate limited and prompts may be logged by provider. No benchmarks found. Prices are OpenRouter list prices (per-token x 1e6) from /api/v1/models on 2026-10-25; they can differ per upstream provider. Context/max output are the top provider values. Latency is estimated: OpenRouter exposes no latency/throughput stats in the public API. Non-coding skill axes derived from coding theta with fixed offsets (tweaked per model), not measured.
